items.html:
Aamer Hameed made two one-day appearances for Pakistan against England in 1977-78, doing enough to win him selection for the tour of England later that year, although he did not come close to a Test call-up. He returned to England in 1979 and won a Blue for Oxford University in an otherwise unmemorable year.
